issue.title: Agents header view hint goes stale when the view picker closes without a change
issue.description: Proposed by phase bead sase-12z.5.2 as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP while integrating the metadata-only Agents default with the visual corpus; forwarded by the sase-12z.5 land agent on 2026-09-20.

task_type_fields.impact:
Cosmetic for users (a stale or briefly missing header hint), but it is a real source of
visual-test flakiness: phase sase-12z.5.2 had to work around it in
`tests/ace/tui/visual/_ace_agents_png_snapshot_helpers.py` by making
`choose_agent_metadata_view` refresh the info panel itself, rather than relying on the
picker. The product fix is to refresh the info panel from the picker's dismiss callback so
every picker exit path repaints the hint; the test-side workaround can then be removed.
task_type_fields.location: src/sase/ace/tui/ Agents view picker dismiss path (_refresh_agent_view_surfaces is not called on no-change or Esc)
task_type_fields.repro:
On the ACE Agents tab, press `p` to open the agent view picker, then either choose the
layout that is already current or dismiss the picker with Esc. The `[view: ... (p)]` hint
in the Agents header is not repainted, because both of those paths skip
`_refresh_agent_view_surfaces`. A countdown tick that fires while the modal is open drops
the hint entirely, and it stays missing until the next tick repaints the header.

payload.description: Epic sase-12z.5 worked around this in tests/ace/tui/visual/_ace_agents_png_snapshot_helpers.py (choose_agent_metadata_view refreshes the info panel); remove that workaround once the picker dismiss callback refreshes the hint.
